description: This file defines the Goteo Console command class 'TranslationsCommand' which manages translation texts and YAML export/import functionalities for the Goteo application.

classes.name: TranslationsCommand
classes.description: A console command class for managing translations, including exporting to YAML and deleting SQL entries related to translations.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up command name, description, options, and help message for the console command.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the translation management logic based on CLI options, including listing, dumping, and deleting translation data.
